deadline: unchanged original third actual cash session
event: already observed low <=origin*.98 => observed, otherwise empirical future m-day minimum low shifted from update close with (hits+.5)/(n+1)
fitting: none; equal weights, inverse empirical CDF; no direction or path conditioning
matured_pool: official origins at index >=252 with next m sessions completed by update close
publishing: chat only, actual saved time, same source gate as current shared forecast; no intraday or retroactive historical forecast
scoring: Count distinct (origin session,deadline); use first timing-qualified original per origin, preserve all snapshots and revisions.
storage: embedded in new atomic manual comparison snapshot; old snapshots immutable
validation_claim: new descriptive product, not validated by package6; differences from original forecast also reflect elapsed information
